summary: Perspective Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a clinical collaboration and supply agreement with Merck to test its targeted alpha-particle therapy [212Pb]PSV359 alongside Merck's Keytruda (pembrolizumab) in FAP-positive solid tumors. The combination is added via amendment to Perspective's ongoing Phase 1/2a study (NCT06710756) in non-small cell lung and colorectal cancer; Perspective sponsors the trial and Merck supplies pembrolizumab at no cost. No prices, stakes, premiums, board recommendation, advisors, or structural/financing terms are stated. This is an ordinary clinical collaboration, so it does not constitute a special situation; monitor trial enrollment, safety, and any Merck option or milestone language.
